summary: All numbers, statuses, and claims in the review cross-check against the evidence: install duration (8044ms), test counts (7/7 pass), claim coverage split (5 PARTIAL/1 UNVERIFIED), peak RAM/duration figures, and reproducibility all match final.json/replay.json/evaluation.json exactly, and the embedded fact-check.json confirms all checks passed. The prose is hedged and specific (e.g., distinguishing ASGI-callable-level verification from real socket/uvicorn testing, noting CLAIM-004 was never exercised), with no inflated language or unearned superlatives. No unsupported claims, exaggerations, mismatches, or unfair conclusions found.
